description: List conversations with optional filters for contact, assignee, status, and search.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

startAfterDate.description: Return conversations after this date (epoch ms)

status.description: Conversation status filter (all, read, unread, starred)

name: crm_list_conversations
